create.title: Blockwise scalar owner completion on the hard top M2 cone
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt X, 1<=L<=J^(1/2), and use one representative orientation a<b with one outer 2Re, the inherited half-open dyadic block lattices and open reciprocal saddle intervals, and the same complete collared hard-top M2 coefficient. Put d(t)=||t||, V_R(t)=eta(Rd(t)), and W_R=V_R-V_(2R), where eta is fixed smooth, equals one on [0,1/2], and vanishes on [1,infinity). For dyadic G_* asymp G, 1_(t notin Z)=sum_(1<=R<G_*, R dyadic)W_R(t)+V_(G_*)(t)-1_(t in Z) pointwise; terminal and annular Fourier coefficients satisfy R^(-1)(1+|nu|/R)^(-M), and for odd g asymp G their |g-2nu|^(plus or minus 1/2) moments are O(G^(plus or minus 1/2)). On the common finite atom space z=(B,a,b,k,g), apply the first matching owner: Round-77 endpoint/collar/original-mode/equality/nonstationary complement; primitive square ray including metric and exact-center pieces; primitive nonsquare exact center; positive-safe block with the fixed rho-boundary and equality on the safe side; residual q=1; residual prescribed-polylogarithmic q>1 shell; residual. The Round-75 diagonal is separate. If Q_B^res, Q_B^comp, and O_(B,nu) are the resulting oriented scalar sums, then coefficientwise Q_B^res=Q_B^comp-sum_nu O_(B,nu), and sum_(B,nu)|O_(B,nu)|<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon. Hence sum_B|Q_B^res|<=sum_B|Q_B^comp|+O_epsilon(L^2X^epsilon), and also |sum_B Q_B^res|<=|sum_B Q_B^comp|+O_epsilon(L^2X^epsilon). Physical completion means only zero extension of the unchanged collared coefficient; floors, stars, equality weights, entry/exit, original Poisson zero modes, metric density, empty/singleton fibres, square/Pell/exact-center atoms, and the conjugate orientation are retained exactly once. This is a scalar linear connector. It proves neither completed directional estimate, supplies no Fejer or Gram cross energy, and implies no hard-cone, smooth-packet, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint, M9, or exponent bound.
create.next_action: Use the completed scalar vector exactly once and prove either its blockwise outside-absolute directional bound or the weaker global signed bound. Do not infer Gram cross energies, delete collars, duplicate orientations, or repeat owner completion.
create.reason_for_promotion: The literal finite owner priority proves one-count coefficientwise completion. Round-77 is absolute per ordered pair; smooth terminal and annular square atoms have uniform sampled-k Fourier half-moment bounds; exact centers and positive-safe blocks are absolute; q=1 and polylog shells have exact scalar Cauchy bridges. A hostile follow-up independently certified the smooth telescoping terminal reconstruction and all normalization seams.

update.statement_tex: For the literal collar-extracted hard top M2 coefficient, put c=X/(2gk), K_alpha(u)=e(sgn(alpha)/8)(2|alpha|)^(-1/2)e(-u^2/(4alpha)), T_alpha f=K_alpha*f, and T_0=I. In tempered distributions, Fourier(T_alpha f)(y)=e(alpha y^2)Fourier(f)(y), T_(-alpha)=T_alpha^(-1)=T_alpha^*, and K_alpha tends to delta_0. For the complete punctured metric window W_R(t)=sum_r W_hat_R(r)e(rt), including W_hat_R(0)=mu_R, sum_r W_hat_R(r)T_(rc)=Fourier^(-1) M_(W_R(cy^2)) Fourier exactly. Thus its L2 norm is int |W_R(cy^2)|^2|Fourier(f)(y)|^2dy and its operator norm is ||W_R||_infinity, independent of rho; at y=sqrt(s)-sqrt(h) it reconstructs W_R(Lambda/k). A second quadratic chirp remains in the same metaplectic family with Jacobian |1-4alpha beta|^(-1/2) and a distributional caustic. The signed linear ray factor is chi_4(a)chi_4(a+2q)=(-1)^q, but in the fixed-a shift-v Gram the Fejer sign times the two character pairs is identically one, so no primitive-character autocorrelation remains. At fixed k the sharp ratio band (1-k/J)^(-1)<sqrt(b/a)<1+2k/J has an exact finite triangular Fourier separation of l1 cost O(log N), but its rank factors are jagged and its continuous Mellin kernel has a 1/xi tail. Exact owner conjugation preserves one-count linearly, and the proved blockwise scalar owner-completion lemma now licenses add-transform-subtract before outside scalar absolute values; it still supplies no Fejer or Gram cross energies. At fixed lift the local character dual length is JG and squared coefficient mass is A. Consequently Gaussian separation, separate metric modes, Plancherel, character B-processes, generic theta notation, and transform inversion supply no rho^(-1/2) linear or rho^(-1) energy gain. The completed actual directional linear and cross-q Gram estimates remain open.
